name: rfid-tigertag
title: TigerTag Filament Tag
author: bespoked
description: Reads TigerTag filament tags (open NTAG21x, no key required) and decodes the physical filament data - color (RGBA), diameter, nozzle and bed temperatures, drying temperature, and weight - into the shared rfid_data.json. The brand and material are stored on a TigerTag as numeric ids whose human-name tables are GPLv3, so this decoder keeps them as ids rather than vendoring a GPL table; the product id is surfaced as the SKU. Works on the standard NTAG reader (no key, no reader change). Installs the RFID Spool Reader automatically. Read-only. Experiment channel until verified on a real tag.
tagline: Decode open TigerTag NTAG spools (color, temps, diameter, weight).
